movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Expressive arm styling allowed especially in open and solo movements; hands maintain connection in closed hold
movement_profile.difficulty: beginner to advanced depending on choreography
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Couple dances in closed and open formations; space used for solo and side-by-side steps
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Smooth, flowing torso movements with controlled hip action
movement_profile.partnering: Partner connection maintained in closed hold; open hold and solo steps permitted
movement_profile.posture: Upright, poised ballroom posture with frame maintained in closed hold; open positions allow freer upper body movement
movement_profile.tempo_feel: Varies by dance; smooth and flowing for waltz and foxtrot, sharp and staccato for tango
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Lifts are banned in standard competition

music_profile.meter: 3/4 for waltz and Viennese waltz; 4/4 for foxtrot and tango
music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Traditional ballroom rhythms characteristic of each dance
music_profile.tempo_bpm: Varies by dance: waltz ~84-90 bpm, Viennese waltz ~180 bpm, foxtrot ~120 bpm, tango ~120 bpm

basic_steps: Transition to open position for solo steps
Return to closed hold for partnered steps
teaching.formation: Couple dancing, alternating between closed hold and open positions
teaching.level_notes: Beginners start with basic closed hold steps; intermediate dancers incorporate open and solo movements; advanced dancers add expressive arm styling and complex footwork
teaching.rhythm: Varies by dance: waltz and Viennese waltz in 3/4 time; foxtrot and tango in 4/4 time
